defs.def: involving the use of skill and the imagination to produce sth new or a work of art 创造（性）的；创作的

ex.s: It uses reclaimed energy creatively.
ex.t: 它创造性地利用了回收的能量。

ex.s: The genius tends to get things done creatively.
ex.t: 获得成功有助于你成为专家。

ex.s: I also enjoy the creative plot and settings.
ex.t: 我也喜欢富有创意的情节和场景。

ex.s: Apart from being a successful statesman, he was also well known as a leading American author, printer and publisher, successful diplomat, creative scientist and inventor.
ex.t: 除了是一位成功的政治家，他还是著名的美国作家、印刷商和出版商、有创造力的科学家和发明家，以及出色的外交家。

ex.s: In 1924, he creatively borrowed “youmo” from Ancient Chinese as the translation for the English word “humour”.
ex.t: 1924年，他创造性地从古汉语中借用"幽默"一词，作为英文单词humour的翻译。

ex.s: He probably didn't realise it at the time, but it was where he learnt to be creative and flexible as a player.
ex.t: 他当时可能没有意识到，但正是在那里他学会了作为一名球员要有创造力和灵活性。

ex.s: With new technological tools at our fingertips, more and more people are exploring their creative sides.
ex.t: 随着新技术工具触手可及，越来越多的人正在探索自己的创造性一面。

ex.s: We welcome volunteers to help transform reclaimed materials into objects with new and creative purposes.
ex.t: 我们欢迎志愿者帮助将回收材料改造成具有新创意用途的物品。

ex.s: Enhance your photography skills — join Yellowstone’s park photographer for a hands-on program to inspire new and creative ways of enjoying the beauty and wonder of Yellowstone.
ex.t: 提升你的摄影技巧——加入黄石公园摄影师的实践项目，激发享受黄石之美与奇迹的新颖创意方式。

ex.s: This camp takes creative license to an entirely new level.
ex.t: 这个夏令营把创作自由发挥到了一个全新的高度。

ex.s: When my mother saw my creations, she told me how creative my designs were. ___34___ I learned a lot about how to extend the life of objects and transform them into something new and useful.
ex.t: 当母亲看到我的作品时，她告诉我我的设计多有创意。___34___ 我学到了很多如何延长物品寿命、把它们改造成新颖有用之物的知识。

defs.def: having the skill and ability to produce sth new, especially a work of art; showing this ability 有创造力的；（尤指艺术作品）创作的；表现创造力的

ex.s: On the basis of that ____53____, I applied to go back to university and study creative writing.
ex.t: 正是基于那次____，我申请重返大学学习创意写作。

ex.s: Organise creative workshops.
ex.t: 设计艺术课程。

ex.s: Turner, a 10th-grader at School for Creative and Performing Arts, is a familiar presence on Cincinnati’s stages.
ex.t: Turner是创意与表演艺术学校的一名十年级学生，在辛辛那提的舞台上是个熟悉的面孔。

ex.s: Creative activities involve being confident.
ex.t: 创造性活动需要自信。

ex.s: greater creative power
ex.t: 对现代艺术的审美评估。

ex.s: I’m enjoying the creative activities, and it feels great to have done something useful.”
ex.t: “我很享受这些创造性活动，做了有益的事感觉很棒。”

ex.s: Wendy Wilson, extra care manager at 60 Penfold Street, one of the first to embark on the project, said: “Residents really welcome the idea of the project and the creative sessions.
ex.t: Penfold街60号的额外护理经理Wendy Wilson是最早参与该项目的人之一，她说："居民们非常欢迎这个项目和创意活动。

ex.s: It will really help connect our residents through a shared interest and creative activities.”
ex.t: 这真的会通过共同兴趣和创造性活动，帮助我们的住户建立联系。

ex.s: It needs to be more creative.
ex.t: 它需要更有创意。

ex.s: Do creative things.
ex.t: 做创意活动。

ex.s: C A cheerful mood helps make a creative mind.
ex.t: C 愉快的心情有助于造就创造性的头脑。

ex.s: What will remain of us when artificial intelligence takes over will be our creativity, and it is our creative spirit, our visionary sense of freshness,that has been our strength for centuries."
ex.t: 扎菲拉库将如何使用她的奖金？

ex.s: Why is it that some people are so much more intelligent or creative than the rest of us?
ex.t: 在科学和艺术领域，那些被誉为天才的大多数是欧洲裔白人男性。

ex.s: The researchers examined various levels of noise on participants as they completed tests of creative thinking.
ex.t: 由于效果很小，这可能表明我们的创造性思维在完全静默和85分贝背景噪音下的反应差别不大。

ex.s: Since the effects were small, this may suggest that our creative thinking does not differ that much in response to total silence and 85 decibels of background noise.
ex.t: 适当水平的背景噪音可能刚好足以打断我们的正常思维模式而不妨碍专注，从而让我们的想象力自由驰骋。

ex.s: But since the results at 70 decibels were significant, the study also suggests that the right level of background noise—not too loud and not total silence—may actually improve one’s creative thinking ability.
ex.t: 但由于70分贝的结果显著，该研究也表明，适当水平的背景噪音——不太响也不完全静默——实际上可能提升一个人的创造性思维能力。

ex.s: This kind of "distracted focus" appears to be the best state for working on creative tasks.
ex.t: 问题可能是，在我们的办公室里，当我们试图集中注意力时无法不被卷入他人的对话中。

ex.s: Indeed, the researchers found that face-to-face interactions and conversations affect the creative process, and yet a coworking space or a coffee shop provides a certain level of noise while also providing freedom from interruptions.
ex.t: 的确，研究人员发现面对面互动和对话会影响创造过程，而联合办公空间或咖啡店提供一定程度的噪音，同时也提供不受打扰的自由。

ex.s: Which level of background noise may promote creative thinking ability?
ex.t: 哪个水平的背景噪音可能促进创造性思维能力？

ex.s: I've always been creative since I was a little girl.
ex.t: 我从小就很有创造力。

ex.s: Somewhere along the way, however, I lost touch with my creative self.
ex.t: 然而在某个时候我与创造性的自我失去了联系。

ex.s: Today I am living a creative life as the designer of my own fashion brand.
ex.t: 如今，作为自己时装品牌的设计师，我过着富有创造力的生活。

ex.s: What did the author do to get back to her creative life?
ex.t: 作者做了什么来回到创造性生活中？

ex.s: creative designs of restaurant menus
ex.t: 餐厅菜单的创意设计

ex.s: If the delay is to make room for creative exploration and forming better social and emotional connections, it is a good thing, he said.
ex.t: 如果这种推迟是为创造性探索和建立更好的社会与情感联结腾出空间，那是好事，他说。

ex.s: Is the writer who wears a fedora more creative?
ex.t: 戴软呢帽的作家就更有创造力吗？

ex.s: Here I will stress some smarter and more creative examples of climate adaptation.
ex.t: 在这里我将强调一些更智能、更有创意的气候适应案例。

defs.def: a person who is creative 富于创造力的人；搞创作的人
creative ideas or material 创意；创作素材

ex.s: Creative Workshops: learn basic repairs and artistic redesign of old furniture, while sharing knowledge and ideas with fellow volunteers,
ex.t: 社会与环境行动：通过创造力和合作帮助应对社会和环境挑战。
